name: Shimmer Myr
oracle_text:
Flash
You may cast artifact spells as though they had flash.
blocked_sentences: You may cast artifact spells as though they had flash.

needs.what: a spell filter (affects_spells: {"types": ["Artifact"]}) on the player-wide cast_as_though_flash static, so the permission covers only artifact spells the controller casts while the source is on the battlefield, read by casting._timing_ok against the CardDef's types
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The cast_as_though_flash static takes only affects_player and an optional condition; the loader refuses 'affects' or 'amount' on it, so it can only grant flash timing to every spell (a strictly better card). The grant_flash_permission op does carry 'types', but it is a one-shot timed permission with a required duration (this_turn / until_your_next_turn), not a continuous static that lasts while Shimmer Myr is on the battlefield. Granting the flash keyword cannot stand in either, since _timing_ok reads printed keywords only.
